text: 交谈开始后，查理像被催眠一般盯着你的眼睛。长谈过后，她痛苦地耸了耸肩。“教授，你说得对。有时候，我们族人的传说也只是故事。我……和你一样理性。”她站起身，开始寻找失踪的学生。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 28
text: Once engaged, Charlie watches your eyes as if hypnotized. After a long talk, she shrugs, pained. “You speak the truth, Professor. Sometimes the legends of my people are just stories. I am… rational, like you.” She stands up and begins to look for the missing student.
